cases.proves_bugs: BUG-236 (the PD1 text is linked to its drain: MOVE of the drain moves the text by the same 1000 mm, ERASE of the drain erases the text, and COPY of the drain gives the copy its own PD2 text and record instead of a second PD1; the text height from Settings is not driven)
cases.title: The PD1 text of a perimeter drain moves with the drain on MOVE and goes with it on ERASE, and a COPY of the drain gets its own PD2 text
cases.plan_item: Perimeter drain tag (triage group R2; daily card D07 neighbour); BUG-236
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-236 in BUG_CARPARK.md (test that catches it: erase / move / copy a perimeter drain: its PD1 text follows or goes; the height reads from Settings). COPY (a second PD1) and the height from Settings are NOT driven here.
cases.expected: After CDPERIMETER places PD1 (polyline and text PD1 on layer AGI DRAIN), a native MOVE of the drain polyline by 0,1000 moves the PD1 text by 1000 as well (its y is 1000 higher), and ERASE of the drain polyline leaves no PD1 text in the drawing. A COPY of the drain by 0,3000 prints "Perimeter drain copy is PD2: it has its own record and its own PD2 text." and adds one PD2 text 3000 higher than PD1 (PD1 and PD2 are then the only PD texts); after the MOVE and the ERASE of the original the copy's PD2 text is still there. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The link between the drawn tag and its drain is kept by CE watching native MOVE and ERASE in the live drawing.
not_automated: Batch 3 fixes of 25 Oct 2026: the COPY half is now driven (probe b3p1: CE prints "Perimeter drain copy is PD2: it has its own record and its own PD2 text." and the copy carries a PD2 MText 3000 higher). Renumbering of a first drain and the text height read from Settings (the R-00 item: the key is not known and ent-read of an MText gives no height) are NOT driven, so BUG-236 is proved for move, erase and copy only.

cases.title: CDCHECKDWG on the current drawing prints one summary line (not a long dump), opens the results window, closes cleanly, and changes nothing in the drawing file
cases.plan_item: CDCHECKDWG (daily card D28; triage groups C2 and W2)
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with daily card D28 (assertions 1 to 4: the four CE lines in order, one summary line matching the layer recognition pattern, at most 5 new CE lines, window title and Close, one new report file beside the drawing, file hash unchanged). BUG-606 says that report file beside the drawing is wrong (approved CV07: reports go to the approved project report location); on 3.0.75 the command still prints "wrote report: <path>" (the case asserts that line) and no file lands beside the drawing; the path is under %APPDATA%, folder TIM_CE_CADTOOLS, subfolder logs, subfolder checkdwg. Whether that folder is the "approved project report location" of BUG-606 and CV7-12 is NOT recorded anywhere found (25 Oct 2026 batch 3 review): the desk owns that question, so this case does not claim BUG-606 is fixed. The case asserts "no report beside the drawing" instead of card step 4 (a new report file beside the drawing); card D28 step 4 is out of date. Batch 3 fixes of 25 Oct 2026: stale sentence replaced, a stray backspace character (left in this file by an earlier sed on the logs\checkdwg path) removed, and the C1 claim dropped (C1 is CDCHECK, not CDCHECKDWG).
cases.expected: CDCHECKDWG with the empty answer prints "[CE] CDCHECKDWG: checking current drawing (...)", "[CE] CDCHECKDWG reading: <path>", exactly one summary line "[CE] CDCHECKDWG: <n>.<n>% layer recognition, <n> unrecognized layers, <n> QA findings ..." and "[CE] CDCHECKDWG wrote report: <path>" (four CE lines, no long dump); the report path is in the CE logs folder under TIM_CE_CADTOOLS (folder logs, subfolder checkdwg), not beside the drawing; the window "Check consultant drawing results (CDCHECKDWG)" opens and its Close button closes it; no report file appears beside the drawing (only AutoCAD lock files and the CE backup are new in the test-copy folder); the drawing file SHA-256 does not change.

The proof that the report went elsewhere is the "wrote report" line carrying TIM_CE_CADTOOLS, and that check did go red in R40_BROKEN.

BUG-790 (design review ignoring office Settings) and BUG-801 (QA going stale) are NOT claimed. The window look is not judged. The "approved project report location" itself is not read: the case only shows that nothing is written beside the drawing.
The report the command now writes to the CE logs folder under %APPDATA% (TIM_CE_CADTOOLS, logs, checkdwg) on this PC is left there (each run adds one small text file); it is not read.
